# Maverick Frame Studio

> > Maverick Frame Studio delivers photorealistic 3D architectural visualization, interior rendering, and product CGI using V-Ray, Corona, and cutting-edge rendering workflows.

Founded by Dmitry Kuzmenko, Maverick Frame Studio has completed 520+ projects across 21 countries, specializing in architectural visualization, real estate marketing, yacht CGI, and premium product rendering for door manufacturers and luxury brands. The studio combines technical expertise in 3ds Max, V-Ray, and BIM integration with a focus on photorealistic quality.

## Key Topics

- Architectural visualization (ArchViz)
- 3D rendering workflows
- Photorealistic CGI
- V-Ray and Corona render engines
- Real estate visualization
- Interior and exterior rendering
- BIM integration
- 3ds Max and SketchUp
- Product visualization
- Yacht CGI
- Cloud rendering
- CGI vs AI workflows
- Maverick Frame Studio team
- London-based 3D services

## Core Services

- [3D Architectural Rendering Services | Photorealistic CGI](https://maverickframe.com/services/3d-architectural-rendering-services): Photorealistic 3D architectural rendering for exteriors & interiors
- [Photorealistic 3D Interior Rendering Services](https://maverickframe.com/services/3d-interior-visualizations): Photorealistic 3D interior rendering for design approval & client pitches
- [Yacht Visualization Services For Marketing & Pre-Sales](https://maverickframe.com/services/yacht-visualization): High-end yacht CGI for pre-launch marketing & design presentation
- [3D Product Visualization For Door Manufacturers](https://maverickframe.com/solutions/3d-product-visualization-for-door-brands-distributors): Premium CGI product visualization services for door manufacturers & brands
